//: Preset for typechecked-but-not-emitted server surfaces: Hono API apps,
test projects, and scripts that Bun executes from TypeScript source.
Bun runs .ts natively, so `noEmit` is the honest setting; `types: ["bun"]`
exposes Bun's globals without pulling Node's type surface into client code.
noImplicitReturns lives here (not in base) because it matches the
historical policy of app/api and the root config, while the shared
declaration/declarationMap are off: a project that does not emit must not
declare types either (declaration emit errors would otherwise surface
for inferred types that cannot be named).
Consumers keep app-specific options (jsx, paths, include) local.
